tools.name: find_services
tools.description: HomeMaster's catalogue: every service it takes today. Call it first, with no arguments, whenever the person names a job, before you say HomeMaster does or does not do it. A service under services is booked online (home cleaning is one): you get its options (for cleaning, visit lengths and how often)

tools.name: check_area
tools.description: Check whether a service is available at a Singapore postal code, before looking for times. Coverage depends on which cleaners or technicians work near the address.

tools.name: find_times
tools.description: Find real open dates, or start times on one date, for a booking at a postal code. Without `date`: the open dates in the next 14 days. With `date` only: that day's start times, each with its price. With `date` and `end_date`: the open dates in that range (at most 14 days). A booking can only start in

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Get the price the checkout will show a new customer, with any evening rate or public voucher it applies. Give `date` and `start_time` (from find_times) for the exact figure for that slot; without them you get the price for that length or job, and the evening rate is described separately. For weekly

tools.name: start_booking
tools.description: Get a link to HomeMaster's checkout with the address and the visit already filled in, to give to the customer. Nothing is booked or charged by this tool. tools.description: Where a request_booking request stands. findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: request_booking · Public sink: start_booking, request_booking.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: request_booking · Public sink: start_booking, request_booking

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "find_services" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
